content_text: [1/2 @FundamentEdge] One of many reasons I am so bullish on agents in the investment process is the trajectory of talent building in this space right now. Just one of many examples: Jack Meehan from Nephron (one of if not the top healthcare sell-side firm) leaving to build an AI-native research company in healthcare. Agents are only as capable as the power of their data inputs & workflow orchestration. And the native data (primarily web-scrape) and workflow orchestration (not buy-side native) is quite bad. But as an ecosystem builds around the agent to unlock the "intelligence overhang", I expect agents to improve materially and reach institutional grade. Pay attention to what Jack does next (and many others like him who are betting their careers on building agent-legible inputs) --- [2/2 @EdgeCGroup] @FundamentEdge The difference between the agents that actually win will be data quality.
